subject: Reconvene: aligning cross-org availability — new security + procurement gatekeepers
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@libertyhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Timing for next demo — a few new reviewers to include

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the time last week. We had planned the product walk-through for Dec 7 at 11:00am PT, but two late changes on your side (welcome!) mean we should reconvene with a slightly different attendee slate. You mentioned procurement and security would like to attend, and Jonas flagged that platform/infrastructure should join for the KV-cache and autoscaling section.

Two constraints I learned from your side: Amit (Procurement) is traveling Dec 7–9 and would prefer the week of Dec 13, while your security lead is flexible but requests a full 90-minute slot to review data flows and retention. We want to make sure we bring the right folks and time.

Can you confirm: are procurement + security mandatory to close the SOW, or is this a staged sign-off? If mandatory, happy to propose new windows. I’ve attached a small availability sheet with our suggested windows.

Next steps I propose:
- Can you confirm mandatory attendees (procurement/security/infra)?
- If yes, pick two candidate windows from the attached spreadsheet and we’ll send an updated invite with an expanded agenda.

Thanks — I’ll loop Karthik (supporting SLA/entitlements) as well once we have a slot.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_availability.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)
From: Priya Shah <pshah@libertyhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Verma <amit.verma@libertyhealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Timing for next demo — a few new reviewers to include

Hi Stephanie,

Appreciate the heads up. To confirm: procurement (Amit) is not strictly required to see the initial demo, but they need to be present for any pricing/contract/cost discussions before we can move to legal. Security is mandatory — our security lead (Anika Rao) needs the full technical dive. Platform/infra are strongly recommended; they’re keen on the autoscaling and KV-cache section but can join for the second half if needed.

Given Amit is traveling Dec 7–9, our preferences are: Dec 13 (anytime PT), Dec 14 (mornings PT), or Dec 15 (afternoons PT). Dec 13 would be ideal.

Can you propose two slots on Dec 13–15? Also share an updated agenda that highlights the security and procurement discussion so we can prep Anika and Amit.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Director of Platform Integrations, LibertyHealth
pshah@libertyhealth.com | +1 617-555-2264

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@libertyhealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-02T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Timing for next demo — a few new reviewers to include

Thanks Priya — good clarity.

Stephanie / team: I pulled together two concrete windows on Dec 13–14 that fit our engineering SMEs and give Anika the 90 minutes she requested. See attached "proposed_availability.xlsx" — the two clean windows are:
- Dec 13, 10:00–11:30 PT (90m) — Security + Platform + Sales overview
- Dec 14, 08:30–10:00 PT (90m) — Alternate, earlier for East Coast stakeholders

I also attached an "updated-demo-agenda.pdf" that splits content into: 1) Business goals & success criteria (20m), 2) Architecture & data flows (30m), 3) Autoscaling/batching/ops (20m), 4) Procurement terms & pricing Q&A (20m).

If Priya confirms Dec 13 10:00 PT, we’ll reserve that and send the invite. Karthik, can you confirm you or someone from entitlements will be available to cover SLA questions in that window?

— Jonas
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachments: updated-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
From: Priya Shah <pshah@libertyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Verma <amit.verma@libertyhealth.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@libertyhealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-03T14:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Timing for next demo — a few new reviewers to include

Jonas — the Dec 13 slot looks good in principle. Quick note: Amit just flagged a last-minute trip extension and now will only be available after Dec 14 afternoon PT. He can dial in for the procurement block (last 20 minutes) if you keep the 90m slot on Dec 13 but he may be on limited connectivity.

Anika (security) prefers Dec 14 morning if possible because she has a conflict on Dec 13 afternoon. Given the mix, is there a way to keep Dec 13 for the main technical run and schedule a short follow-up on Dec 14 specifically for procurement and any remaining security deep-dives? That might reduce the chance of missing a sign-off conversation.

If Redwood prefers a single session, we can do Dec 14 08:30 PT. Otherwise propose: primary demo Dec 13 10:00–11:00 PT (60m condensed demo + 30m breakout for security/procurement), then optional procurement follow-up Dec 14 09:00–09:30 PT.

Priya

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@libertyhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Amit Verma <amit.verma@libertyhealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T16:23:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dec 13 10:00–11:30 PT (primary) + Dec 14 09:00–09:30 PT (procurement follow-up) — invite sent

Thanks everyone — we’ll do the two-part approach to make sure Anika and Amit get the time they need without blocking the whole program.

What I’ve done:
- Reserved Dec 13, 10:00–11:30 PT as the primary demo (agenda attached).
- Added a short procurement follow-up on Dec 14, 09:00–09:30 PT.
- Sent calendar invites (redwood-demo-invite.ics) to all participants.
- Added Karthik to the procurement Q&A block and Jonas will own the security breakout.

Please accept the invites. If anything changes on your travel side, flag me and we’ll adapt — we know these windows are tight around year-end.

— Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
